manifest.protocol: Same architecture/dataset/train-protocol/optimizer/budget as Phase 14 JointCo baseline (mixed F+R+C, AdamW lr=0.003, best-val checkpoint, frozen at eval). Only the relational substep varies (depth / aggregation / update capacity). Router frozen.
